2GiB per-file RLIMIT, exact full five payload sizes, total/auxiliary budgets and failed-run full file hash manifest remain.

limitations_or_followup: Storage watchdog is sampled, not kernel quota/reservation: a burst can temporarily exceed caps before next sample. User approved policy must accept that stated limitation.

Policy constructor/pre-run storage validation can fail before durable profile_provenance exists. This is fail-closed before target launch, but root should retain launcher log and explicit preflight-rejection receipt; do not infer unrecorded attempt success. It is an auditability follow-up, not a scientific acceptance bypass.

Read-only binding verification hashes potentially large input assets before/after subprocesses; storage/tree scans add host profiling overhead. New profiling must remain separate from primary timings.
No tested runtime/cgroup/NCU result is claimed. Capacity observations are not reservations; later runtime guard may legitimately reject.
